audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 against a 46.74% win rate over 582 games is defensible and the mirror deliberately left the same rating in place.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Tryndamere levels 2, 3, first item and called 4-5 and 6 even, while every matching content why said the stage was Kled's. Five rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: The mirror settled the chart as Skill / Kled / Kled / Kled / Kled / Kled / Tryndamere. Kled owns the lane while he is mounted; the flip is your two-item crit-lifesteal scaling, not a lane spike.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 flipped to Kled in matched pairs with ratings adjusted, whys[0] rewritten so the even level-1 row reads even, and the full-layer whys rewritten to name the real mechanics.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Dodge his pull' was the whole of the ability advice, and no cooldown or range appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope hooks at 800 and the yank only lands after the shackle holds for a short duration, so leaving the rope's reach with Spinning Slash cancels the pull — a dodge is not the only counterplay and often not the available one. Violent Tendencies is four attacks with the fourth the biggest, on 13/12/11/10/9. Jousting is a 550 dash he can recast back through you. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and grants a shield.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, spikes[0], spikes[1], mid and four phase whys rewritten around those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Let him remount' was listed as a mistake with no explanation of how remounting works.
audit.why: Skaarl's courage refills by fighting enemies, so continuing the fight after you dismount him is what gives him the mount back.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d and phases[5].why now say to disengage once Skaarl drops.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Kled contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Spin up fury on the wave. Bear Trap on a Rope reaches 800 — stand behind minions so the rope has something else to catch.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies gives him four fast attacks and the fourth hits hardest — trade before it starts, never during it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kled must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Jousting is a 550 dash he can recast back through you, so he picks both ends of the trade. Give him nothing here.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Skaarl's health is a second bar, not yours to burst through: crit him off the mount first, and only then take the extended fight you actually want.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage buys survival, not the duel: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140 seconds but it shields him and rams you, so his level 6 outweighs yours in a straight fight.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker helps you stick, but he remounts by fighting, so leave once you knock Skaarl down.

edits.before: Level 1 goes to Kled: Q pull into W burst and mounted HP win the trade outright.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: his Q reaches 800, but one rope with no W yet is survivable.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1, 800 range — the yank is delayed, so spin away and it never lands. - Violent Tendencies: 13s, four attacks, biggest on the fourth. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 140s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope: His engage hook. Dodge it. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: Bear Trap yanks after a delay — Spinning Slash out of the rope and the pull never happens.

edits.before: His engage hook. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The yank is delayed — spin out of its reach and the rope drops off.

edits.before: That is Kled's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Kled's whole opener — stand behind a minion and the rope catches it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: He refills Skaarl's courage by fighting; disengage once he dismounts.

edits.before: Kled dominates early: his Q Bear Trap on a Rope pulls and slows you, W Violent Tendencies gives him a burst of empowered autos, and mounted on Skaarl he simply out-trades your crits with more effective HP; avoid extended fights and give up CS rather than eat a Q pull into his W burst.
edits.after: Kled dominates early: Bear Trap on a Rope hooks from 800 and yanks you in after a delay, Violent Tendencies gives him four fast attacks with the fourth hitting hardest, and mounted on Skaarl he out-trades your crits. Spin out of the rope before the yank, and give up CS rather than eat the trap into that burst.

edits.before: Kled stays ahead at level 6: his R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is roam and engage pressure, and in lane he out-sustains and out-trades you while mounted, so respect his all-in and use Undying Rage purely to survive rather than to win the duel.
edits.after: Kled stays ahead at level 6: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140 seconds but it shields him and rams the first champion it reaches, and mounted he out-trades you in lane — so spend Undying Rage to survive his commit, not to win the duel through it.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay Kled's — mounted on Skaarl he out-sustains and out-trades your crits, and even Undying Rage only buys you survival, not a won duel; wait for him to overextend or get dismounted rather than forcing fights.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 stay Kled's — mounted on Skaarl he out-sustains your crits, and Violent Tendencies' four attacks end on his biggest hit. Undying Rage buys survival, not a won duel; wait for him to overextend or dismount.

edits.before: Survive the brutal early lane by giving up CS over eating Q pulls
edits.after: Spin out of the Bear Trap rope before its delayed yank lands on you

notes: Every full-layer side on rows 2 through 6 contradicted its own content why before this edit — the page told the reader Tryndamere wins level 2 and level 3 in the chart while the text under it said Kled wins both. report[8] recommends Executioner's Calling because 'his healing fights your pattern'; nothing in Kled's kit file heals, so that line is probably inherited boilerplate and should be re-checked by whoever owns the item text. As in the mirror, I did not restate the unverified 'unkillable for 5 seconds' figure in any new text.
